curation.reason: Add original reviewed representative vehicle schematics for exact known configurations. Data and art only; no source fact, lifecycle, role, origin, geography or retained asset correction.

features: Long March 6A two liquid core stages, 3.35 m core, four 2 m solid boosters and approximately 50 m overall length, from CASC manufacturer text.

CASC Eighth Academy authored whole first-flight render and pad photo show the published wider rounded fairing, four pointed solid booster noses and long unboosted upper core; distinct from Long March 6 and 6C.
coverage.limitations: Original source-dated representative schematic, not an engineering reconstruction, launch photograph, exact paintwork or mission-specific fairing/recovery choice. Published overall/core dimensions set aspect ratio where stated. Fairing lengths, collar/stage stations and unpublished dimensions are illustrative inspected-image proportions; they are not new catalog facts. Side boosters show total count in a flattened informational view. No logos, manufacturer graphics or photographs are redistributed. Exact configuration labels, provider facts, operator/manufacturer/origin/site roles and unknown values are preserved. 2022 first-flight representative. The whole render and pad photo are primary manufacturer-authored materials explicitly credited to CASC Eighth Academy on the hosting article. The news article is a host/credit locator, not an independent source for technical facts. Fairing diameter 4.2 m and stations are image-derived plotting proportions, not newly verified engineering dimensions; other published fairing options are not flight selections.
